name: Martha Lamoreaux
openQuestionsNew: She is probably the wife of 'Samuel Prindle' (female aged 26-44) in the 1800 Plymouth Twp census (see Samuel Pringle), consistent with a birth c.1770-74 rather than the FamilySearch 1776.
Look for her as a widow in the 1850 Plymouth/Kingston census (Samuel d. 1847) to fix her birth year and test the FS death date 27 Aug 1859, which duplicates her sister Elizabeth Ransom's.
